sources.title: Drugs@FDA database and downloadable data files
sources.role: Primary application/product history and approved decision evidence
sources.coverage: Most human drug products approved since 1939; depth of review documents is greater for later years
limitations: Approved-product records alone do not enumerate all submitted applications or all non-approval review cycles
Approval supplements, original applications, resubmissions, and review cycles must be distinguished
Decision date and outcome must be verified at the application/review-cycle level

sources.title: FDA Complete Response Letter transparency database
sources.role: CRL event discovery and supporting source documents
sources.coverage: Selective released CRLs; current API documentation describes 2020-2024 coverage with additional archival releases
limitations: Publication is selective and release batches are not a representative sample of all FDA review outcomes
CRL is a review-cycle non-approval outcome, not necessarily permanent application failure
CRL-only counts must never be used as the denominator for approval probability

sources.title: FDA Drugs@FDA approval packages and multidisciplinary reviews
sources.role: Adjudicate approval action, application type, review cycle, and source documents
limitations: Only use evidence that was publicly available before the target decision when constructing predictors
An approval package can verify an approval but cannot alone enumerate all applications that were not approved

cohort_rules: Define the target population before counting outcomes, such as original NDA/BLA review cycles by year and center
Count each application review cycle as the outcome unit and preserve later cycles as separate outcomes only under a predeclared analysis plan
Reconcile the full denominator against a source that enumerates the defined population, not only published CRLs or approvals
Record approval, complete response, withdrawal, refusal-to-file, and unresolved outcomes separately; do not silently force them into binary labels
Capture predictors only from dated sources available strictly before each decision date
Require independent adjudication of application identity, decision date, outcome, and predictor cutoff
Do not authorize training or probability output until source coverage and outcome ascertainment are independently reconciled
